name: QphoX
description: QphoX develops quantum transducers that convert quantum information between microwave and optical frequencies, enabling quantum computers to network over standard telecom fiber. A spin-off from TU Delft's Quantum Nanoscience department, QphoX launched the first commercial quantum transducer in March 2026.

news.title: QphoX Launches Breakthrough Product Allowing Distributed Quantum Computing Over Long-distance Optical Networks
news.excerpt: QphoX's new Quantum Transducer allows quantum information to travel through optical fiber networks at room temperature and over large distances. IBM will work with the Quantum Transducer to connect superconducting qubits via the company's Quantum Networking Unit test devices. The product will enable the growth of distributed, modular quantum computers operating across long distances.
